meta.title: Caishen Fortune Sticks - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Draw a fortune stick from the sixty-two Caishen oracle sticks. Hold your question about wealth, career, or business in mind, then draw for guidance. Data comes from public traditional culture sources and is for entertainment only.
caishen.desc: The Caishen oracle holds sixty-two fortune sticks for questions of wealth, career, and business — draw a stick to see what to gain and what to watch out for.
caishen.drawTip: Quiet your mind and focus on your question — about wealth, career, or investment — then draw a stick.
